name: Berkeley Earth Global Surface Temperature Dataset
description: The Berkeley Earth Surface Temperature dataset is an independent, high-resolution scientific reconstruction of global land and ocean temperature changes from 1750 (land) and 1850 (land-ocean) to the present. Developed to address debates regarding station selection bias, urban heat islands, and data adjustments, Berkeley Earth applies automated algorithmic breakpoint detection and spatial network weighting across more than 50,000 distinct weather stations. The resulting dataset provides monthly and daily 1°x1° gridded temperature anomalies and regional averages.
